purpose: Compare warm-start reuse of the frozen Step-9A deployment weights against scratch initialization on the same leakage-safe Step-10 mixture while independently protecting original-domain performance.

training.domain_schedule: equal optimizer-block count from original and bridge per epoch; shorter block list cycles deterministically

selection.retention_reference: matching-seed warm-start epoch-0 original-domain selection metrics
eligibility: original mechanism balanced accuracy >= warm-start epoch-0 original mechanism BA - 0.02
original effect balanced accuracy >= warm-start epoch-0 original effect BA - 0.02
eligible_checkpoint_order: minimum(original mechanism BA, bridge mechanism BA)

evaluation.seed_aggregation: mean logits across seeds after per-seed checkpoint selection
evaluation.effect_threshold: one threshold per initialization selected from concatenated original+bridge selection logits, then frozen for both outer domains

original_retention_gate.reference: untouched warm-start Step-9A ensemble evaluated on the same original outer-development validation cohort
